title: Setup and Operation of Single Use Bubble Column Reactors for Recombinant Proteins
author: Nathan Wright
materials: Allow incubator to reach set temperature.
Flash freeze the cell pellet in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare Media and BCR Bags
steps.instruction: Prepare and autoclave Terrific Broth Base including Trace elements (Formedium AIMTB310). To each litre of sterilised media, add 1 mL of 10% Antifoam 204, 1 mL of 1000x antibiotic stock (e.g., Kanamycin 50mg/ml), and 20 g of glycerol.

steps.title: Set Up BCR Bags
steps.instruction: Add 1 L of the prepared AIM TB media to each BCR bag and insert sparger stones, ensuring they are at the bottom of the BCR.

steps.title: Initiate Culture and Aeration
steps.instruction: Transfer BCR bags to the incubator. Attach sparger stones to air control valves and set the air flow to 1 lpm.

steps.title: Inoculate Culture
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of starter culture per L of main culture.

steps.title: Initial Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for approximately 4 hours (or until the culture enters the exponential growth phase, typically 4-6 hours).

substeps.instruction: Reduce incubation temperature before the autoinduction point (OD600 between 3-5) to promote protein solubility.

steps.title: Overnight Expression Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at ambient temperature overnight (approximately 16 h).

substeps.instruction: Note: Without external cooling, metabolic activity will heat the culture to 25-27 °C; use an external recirculating chiller if proteins are temperature sensitive.

steps.title: Harvest Culture
steps.instruction: Perform final culture processing and biomass collection.

substeps.instruction: Take final OD600 reading.
Collect 1 mL culture samples for diagnostic testing.
Place BCR bags into a large jug; make a small incision near the top of the liquid level, then larger incisions at the bottom to drain culture into the jug.
Transfer culture to 1 L centrifuge bottles.

steps.title: Cell Pellet Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Isolate and store the cell biomass.

substeps.instruction: Pellet the cells at 4000 rcf, 4 °C, for 30 minutes.
Drain spent media and sterilise with 1 tablet/L Virkon.
Record wet cell weight (g).
Transfer cell pellet to cryo-safe sample bags with clear tracking information.
Store cell pellet at -80 °C.

steps.title: Rapid Over-expression Assay (Mag Prep)
steps.instruction: Perform an abridged assay using Nickel Magnetic Beads to verify over-expression.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of culture sample to a microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 µL lysis reagent to the sample (use a larger pellet first if biomass/expression is low).
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes in a tube rotor.
Aspirate the soluble fraction (mixed proteins) with a pipette.
Add 50 µL magnetic IMAC beads to the soluble fraction.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes in a tube rotor.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute in a magnetic separator stand.
Aspirate soluble fraction (unbound material) and reserve for SDS-PAGE analysis.
Wash the retained beads with 2 mL binding buffer for 1 minute.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute in a magnetic separator stand.
Aspirate soluble fraction (unbound material) and reserve for SDS-PAGE analysis.
Add 50 µL elution buffer to the magnetic beads.
Aspirate the soluble fraction (eluted protein) with a pipette.

steps.title: Analysis and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify and verify the expressed protein.

substeps.instruction: Measure A280 using a spectrophotometer (e.g., NanoDrop).
Run an SDS-PAGE gel to check for over-expression and quality control.
Pellet cell debris at maximum speed (16000 rpm) in a microtube centrifuge for 2 minutes.
